aviation.disclaimer: ⚠️ Aviation Mode Limitation: Live METAR/TAF feeds, SIGMET/AIRMET bulletins, and PIREP icing/turbulence reports are not yet integrated. Ceiling, visibility, and crosswind assessments shown here are derived from general NWP forecast data and must NOT be used for flight planning or operational dispatch. Always consult official aviation weather sources (e.g., NOAA AWC, Jeppesen, local ATC) before any flight operations.

marine.disclaimer: ⚠️ Marine Mode Limitation: Real-time buoy observations, official tide-gauge data, sea surface temperature (SST) from satellite feeds, and coast-guard small-craft/gale advisories are not yet integrated. Wave and swell estimates shown here are derived from general NWP forecast models and must NOT be used for maritime navigation or voyage planning. Always consult official marine weather services (e.g., IMD Marine, NOAA NWS Marine, local port authority).
